The Redeemed Christian Church of God is set to expand access to kidney treatment in Edo State with the commissioning of a new dialysis centre at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital, Benin City. The facility, named the Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, is an initiative of His Love Foundation, the church’s Christian Social Responsibility arm, and is expected to strengthen the hospital’s capacity to provide treatment for patients requiring regular dialysis. The centre is scheduled to be commissioned on November 24, 2026, by the Edo State Governor, Monday Okpebholo, according to a statement obtained by The PUNCH on Tuesday. The project adds to the foundation’s network of dialysis facilities across the country, bringing to 15 the number of centres listed by the organisation in different states and the Federal Capital Territory. The existing facilities are located in Lagos, Abuja, Bauchi, Ogun, Ondo, Oyo, Anambra, Borno, Enugu, Osun, Akwa Ibom, Ekiti and Delta states. The foundation said the intervention was part of its broader commitment to improving access to specialised healthcare and addressing humanitarian needs through practical social interventions. Beyond healthcare, His Love Foundation operates programmes covering education, feeding, social enterprise, environmental architecture, prison impact and rehabilitation. The organisation said its interventions had reached communities in 650 local government areas across the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. The foundation, established as the social responsibility arm of the RCCG, said its activities were driven by the objective of demonstrating Christian values through interventions in healthcare, education and social welfare. Ayoola Babalola
